questions.question: When Peter pointed out that the fig tree Jesus had cursed was withered, what did Jesus tell the disciples?
When Jesus entered the temple courts in Jerusalem and found people buying and selling there, what did He do?

answers.text: He began to drive them out
He sat down and watched them
He bought a dove for an offering

questions.question: Jesus said God's house should be called a house of prayer for all the nations. What did He say the people had turned it into?
When you stand to pray and hold something against someone, what did Jesus say to do?

answers.text: Forgive what you hold against them
